meta.title: About · YukSaroy
meta.description: YukSaroy is a catalog of freight terminals, private sidings, rail equipment and road transport in Uzbekistan. See prices and contact the owner directly.

about.title: Freight services, gathered in one place
about.lead: A terminal, a siding, a wagon or a truck is still found by word of mouth. We gathered that search into one open place: the price is visible and you message the owner yourself.

who.heading: Who we are
who.body: A team that has worked in freight logistics for years. Finding a terminal, asking for a tariff, catching a free wagon is all still done by phone. We turned it into one open catalog, across Uzbekistan, in three languages.

what.heading: What the platform does
what.i1: Terminal services: tariff, working hours, free spots today, booking and documents.
what.i2: Registry of sidings: grouped by station, the owner claims and gets their page.
what.i3: Rail equipment and road transport listings: rent or sale, with the owner's page.
what.i4: Companies: the verified badge, their terminals and contacts.

open.title: Open pricing
open.body: Tariffs and listing prices are visible without signing in. No hidden prices: look, compare and pick what fits.

fair.title: Fair placement
fair.body: The ordering is open: newest, price or distance. Premium only rises within that order and is marked with a badge. No hidden ads.

owners.title: Owners' listings
owners.body: Every object belongs to its owner. The owner sets the terms and answers your request. We do not stand in between or change the data.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.body: For a question, a demo or a partnership, write through the form and we reply within 24 hours. The Telegram bot also has the catalog and requests.
